attacksRun.attack: 'the four reserved surfaces' is an invented count - contract v5 has eight surfaces and only one carries thisClosure RESERVED (S-ROLE).
attacksRun.evidence: Pressed hard, because 'four' is new text absent from both v2 and v5. It is grounded in the very C3 packet that D-293 Decision 6 adopted: DECISION-PACKETS/C1-4-reserved-numbers-security-quality.md line 386 - 'the surfaces whose windows this decision would fill are four (S-CORE, S-SCHEMA, S-TS1 with windows RESERVED; S-CTRL with window SEMANTICS reserved); S-STATE carries no window text in its skeleton; S-RUST2/S-ROLE/S-EVIDENCE are unshipped / reserved / deferred'. The packet's DR-111 fill-in form lists exactly those four window fields. 'Reserved' here modifies the window standing, which is v5's own skeleton wording, not S-ROLE's thisClosure value. The phrase also occurs only inside negative refusal clauses, so it mints nothing either way.

attacksRun.attack: D-293 Decision 6 is mischaracterised, or does not reach DR-111.
attacksRun.evidence: COORD D-293 Decision item 6 is 'C1-C4' and reads in part 'C2 and C3 as agreed (the C2 matrix/corpus, threshold-approval and G13 sequence; the C3 live-file-08 remasurement with coherent evaluable windows)'. The packet heading is 'C1-C4 - Reserved numbers/lists: DR-112, DR-118, DR-111, DR-126', so C3 is DR-111, and packet section 3 is titled 'C3 - DR-111 compatibility: numeric reader-support windows'. The subject's decisionItem 6, its adoption commit c10319d2 (verified: 'D-293: record owner decisions on DECISIONS-NEEDED A-F'), and its paraphrase all hold.

The packet's own fill-in form confirms the unit is 'not fixed by the record' and every per-surface value is an unfilled blank. whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of compatibility leftover-join.v3 as a CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED leftover remasurement of the DR-111 row against live file 08 e503b75b..., at HEAD 83de4c66..., under D-293 Decision 6 limb (i). It is a Stage A independent review only.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.notSatisfied: It does not make DR-111 SATISFIED, does not make it D-056-eligible, and does not discharge gates 2 or 3. OBL-NUMERIC-WINDOWS and OBL-LOCK-JOIN remain leftover-design.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.notAnApplication: It does not apply compatibility-matrices-contract.v5, does not bind anything, does not seal, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.notLimbTwo: It says nothing about the window unit, whether the four surfaces share one window, or any window value. Limb (ii) of D-293 Decision 6 remains a named open decision.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.notARecording: It is not the recording act. Recording requires the owner's D-000 cycle with both Stage A reviews in hand; until then compatibility leftover-join.v2 remains the current recorded DR-111 leftover-join.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.notFile08: No file 08 or COORD edit is proposed, endorsed, or made by this review.
whatThisAcceptDoesNotDo.remeasurementCondition: If any cited file moves other than by append-only COORD growth or COORD heading hygiene, this ACCEPT is spent and the subject must be remasured before recording.

verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty-two attacks run, thirty-two refuted, zero sustained.
